settings.heading: Kratom, without the games.
settings.lede: Dandy exists because buying kratom online is mostly awful — vague labels, no lab reports, and wild claims nobody stands behind.

settings.heading: Why we started
settings.body: Most kratom is sold either as a mystery bag or a miracle cure. Neither is honest. We wanted a version you could hand to a curious friend without a disclaimer: an exact labeled amount, an independent lab report for every batch, and plain language about what it does and doesn't do.

settings.heading: What we promise
settings.body:
An exact amount. 35 mg per gummy, measured — not estimated.

A report for every batch. Identity, potency, heavy metals, microbials. Batch number printed on the pouch.

Honest limits. We'll tell you when something isn't for you, when a format is cheaper elsewhere in our own range, and when we don't know.

settings.heading: The raccoon
settings.body: Rocky is on every pouch. He's a scavenger with excellent taste and no patience for nonsense, which felt about right.
